earliest.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 UTC calendar dates. DTE is UTC date difference.

delta.description: Signed delta, not absolute delta; puts normally have negative delta.

max_relative_spread.description: (ask-bid)/((ask+bid)/2); zero mid is unavailable, never zero spread.

target.description: When set, compare absolute distance from this target.

complete_pointer.description: RFC6901 pointer whose actual provider value must be boolean true.

scope_pointer.description: Exact provider scope identity; the host does not infer a global market.

candidate_input.description: Exact candidate table and ID projection in one admitted named input.

oneOf.description: Complete only relative to the explicit configured provider input scopes.
